## Research change

### Gate
- [ ] This PR names the research gate it changes.
- [ ] Scientific status is stated explicitly.

### Frozen-spec discipline
- [ ] Seeds, thresholds, generator parameters, estimator, and bootstrap policy are unchanged, or the PR explicitly declares a new pre-result spec version.
- [ ] Source/provenance hashes are recorded where applicable.
- [ ] Generated evidence is kept separate from code changes.

### Claim firewall
- [ ] No synthetic result is generalized to human selfhood, consciousness, qualia, soul, afterlife, or ontological nonexistence claims.
- [ ] INCONCLUSIVE is not rewritten as absence/equivalence.
- [ ] Oracle-U diagnostics are not presented as structural evidence.

### Falsification
- [ ] The PR states what result would reduce, withdraw, or stop the proposed claim.
